'''Premiere Sealed''' is a sealed deck format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015). Each player opens one [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] starter deck and builds a deck from it.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' one Premiere starter deck per player
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015; events not recorded
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Each player needs one Premiere starter deck. The format uses the guide's '''Sealed''' rules:<ref name="afg" />
* Product stays unopened until each player is paired with a first opponent and assigned a side of the Force, which the player keeps for the whole tournament.
* Both players open everything at the same time. The Dark Side player gives all Light Side cards to the opponent and the Light Side player gives all Dark Side cards, face down, without either player seeing them. Each player keeps the cards received after the tournament.
* If a player has no opponent to swap with, the Tournament Director swaps with that player from an extra sealed deck.
* Deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks.
* No cards may be added from outside the tournament or by trading, but a player may re-customize the deck between games from the original stock of sealed cards.

The guide does not give a deck size for this format. Sealed deck games are timed at one minute per card in the deck (40 minutes for 40-card decks). A tournament has at least three games, then a Final Confrontation between the top Light Side and top Dark Side players, timed at 1.5 times the normal game length.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
Decipher's own tournament guide (2002) described the Star Wars CCG sealed deck tournament as played with unopened starter decks: Dark and Light players swapped the opposite side's cards, built 40-card decks in about 30 minutes, and played 60-minute games with a final confrontation between the top Dark and top Light players.<ref name="dec-tg">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/tournamentguide-stswyj.asp Tournament Guide: Star Trek CCG, Star Wars CCG, Young Jedi CCG], Decipher, "The Sealed Deck tournament". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020606155553/http://tournaments.decipher.com/tournamentguide-stswyj.asp Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee guide lists Premiere Sealed first among its sealed deck formats.<ref name="afg" /> No event in this format is recorded on this wiki.
